en.meta_description: Fuji finger tape for jiu-jitsu and judo: 6 rolls with a storage case, tears by hand, sweat-resistant fabric. Bought from the US for you; 7–14 business days.
en.headline: Six rolls of sweat-resistant Fuji finger tape in a handy case
en.intro: This Fuji finger tape is made for jiu-jitsu and judo training, and its sweat-resistant fabric gives a strong grip. After you order, FeelBetter buys it from the seller in the United States and ships it to you.
highlights: The sweat-resistant fabric gives a strong grip and a better hold during training.
The pack has 6 rolls, each about 30 ft (about 9 m) long.
The tape tears by hand without scissors, and the rolls come in a convenient storage case.
No messy, sticky residue is left behind after you remove it.
It is designed with increased structural integrity to help protect your fingers in training and competition.

sections.p: Wrap it around your fingers before jiu-jitsu or judo training and tear it off by hand, with no scissors needed. When you remove it, it does not leave messy, sticky residue behind.

Each roll is 0.5 in (1.27 cm) wide and about 30 ft (about 9 m) long, and the pack contains 6 rolls with a storage case. Please choose your color from the options on this page: Black/White, White or Black.

cautions: The tape is 0.5 in (1.27 cm) wide; please check that this width suits your use.

6롤 구성이고 한 롤의 길이가 약 9m(30피트)예요.
가위 없이 손으로 찢어 쓸 수 있고, 롤은 편리한 보관 케이스에 담겨 있어요.

구조 강도를 높여 훈련과 시합에서 손가락을 보호하는 데 도움이 되도록 만들었어요.

cautions: 테이프 너비는 1.27cm(0.5인치)예요. 용도에 맞는지 확인해 주세요.

はがしたあとに、べたつくのり残りがありません。
構造強度を高めた設計で、練習や試合で指を守るのに役立ちます。

Se rasga a mano sin necesidad de tijeras, y los rollos vienen en un práctico estuche.

Está diseñada con mayor resistencia estructural para ayudar a proteger los dedos en entrenamientos y competiciones.

de.headline: Sechs Rollen schweißresistentes Fuji-Fingertape im praktischen Etui

Die Packung enthält 6 Rollen, jede etwa 9 m (30 Fuß) lang.
Das Tape lässt sich ohne Schere von Hand abreißen, und die Rollen stecken in einem praktischen Etui.
Nach dem Entfernen bleiben keine klebrigen Rückstände zurück.
Dank erhöhter Stabilität soll es Ihre Finger im Training und im Wettkampf schützen.

sections.p: Wickeln Sie das Tape vor dem Jiu-Jitsu- oder Judo-Training um Ihre Finger und reißen Sie es von Hand ab, ganz ohne Schere. Beim Abnehmen bleiben keine klebrigen Rückstände zurück.

cautions: Das Tape ist 1,27 cm (0,5 Zoll) breit; bitte prüfen Sie, ob das zu Ihrem Bedarf passt.
